name: OpenRouter
description: Read-only OpenRouter access: the account's key limits and usage, the full catalogue of 300+ routable models with pricing, and the prepaid credit balance. Sending a chat completion is a billable POST against those same credits, so it is modelled as write:true and HITL-gated rather than fired here; every other Quox agent tool for governed model routing sits on top of this connector unchanged.

tools.name: get_key
tools.description: Get the OpenRouter API key's own account info: label, current usage, credit limit and whether it is a free-tier key. The cheap balance/limits read and the spec's auth-proving call

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every model routable through OpenRouter's 300+ model catalogue, with context length and per-token pricing. Publicly readable, this endpoint answers even without a valid key

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Get the OpenRouter account's prepaid credit balance: total credits purchased and total credits used so far

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Send a chat completion to any OpenRouter-routed model. This spends the account's prepaid credits, so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness (write:true means blind proof always SKIPs it; a real credential would also need --include-writes)

model.description: OpenRouter model id to route to (e.g. openai/gpt-4o, anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet), from list_models

needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real sk-or- key against /key, /models and /credits, all zero-spend authed reads per the build plan.

TEMPLATE SEED: this spec is the intended template for the sibling OpenAI-compatible gateways (Groq, Together, Fireworks, xAI, DeepSeek), which share the same Authorization: Bearer + GET /v1/models shape and can inherit this structure near-verbatim.

list_models is expected to answer even with a dummy/invalid bearer (it is OpenRouter's public model catalogue), which the shape-proof harness would classify as SHAPE_PROVEN via the public_endpoint (2xx + parseable JSON) rule rather than the auth-wall rule that /key and /credits earn.

chat_completion is the only write:true tool: it is modelled for completeness (per the build plan) but deliberately carries no _probe and is skipped by the shape-proof harness by default (writes_not_included), and even with --include-writes it only fires if the test call already proved an auth gate.
